due_at.description: When its 7 days of notice end and a Super admin may complete it.

ended_by.description: Who objected, withdrew or completed it.

evidence_kind.description: What it rests on: a board resolution, or the external accountant's recorded confirmation (FR-DOC-05).

files.description: How many evidence files are attached: completing it needs at least one.

outgoing.description: The Owner whose membership it ends.

reason.description: Why, as the Owner who started it gave it.
examples: Ben left the company on 31 October; the board resolved on his removal

started_at.description: When; the outgoing Owner was told then.

status.description: notice while it waits; objected by the outgoing Owner; withdrawn by the one who started it; completed by a Super admin.

successor.description: The member who becomes an Owner when it completes; absent when it names none.

you_may_attach.description: Whether you may attach evidence to it now: an Owner other than the outgoing one, while it waits.

you_may_complete.description: Whether you, a Super admin, may complete it now: its notice is over and a file is attached.

you_may_object.description: Whether you, the outgoing Owner, may object to it now.

you_may_withdraw.description: Whether you, who started it, may withdraw it now.
